notes: Recommended workflow and current implementation are separate fields.
auto_mode is a legacy detector-capability field, not the recommended workflow.
Review status and data origin are not semantic labels.
Automatic candidates are predictions, not automatically human-reviewed reference data.
The current motion score measures relative salience, not calibrated accuracy.
Speech turns are built from already-attributed speech; no diarization or ASR is included.
Object registry entries do not establish geometry, contact or support automatically.
Cross-track cooccurrence is computed; it does not establish communicative meaning.
Activity Relation is historical. Broad Motion Primitive proposals can stay pending; Accept a specific form when supported.
Gaze/face annotations are retired from new annotation scope; legacy records remain.
Hand placement, self-contact and observable self-support are separate supported descriptions; proximity does not prove contact or force.
Use one specificity level for the same relation; distinct hand shape, posture, object relation and speech may coexist with independent boundaries.
Affect offers Adjective + intensity or Valence / Arousal as independent editor modes; the dimensional rating record does not require an emotion category.
Spatial also supports person-to-named-object states and movement. Only an object name is required for registration; no model assets or geometry are prerequisites for manual annotation.
Activity Episode records a whole observable activity by actor, with an optional named object and description.

categories.name: Activity Episode
categories.description: An observable activity performed by one actor over a meaningful interval. Record a reusable activity name, an optional named object, and an optional description of how the activity was performed.
categories.evidence_mode: video or direct observation of the activity
categories.boundary_rule: Start at the first action that constitutes the named activity. End when it stops or changes to a different activity.

categories.name: Motion Primitive
categories.description: Observable movement form or maintained state of a body part; communicative meaning is recorded separately.
categories.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics
categories.boundary_rule: Start at the first clear departure from the preceding pose; end when the movement stops or its form changes. Split reversals for directional primitives; repeated movement patterns use their own bout boundaries. Do not include unrelated preparation or rest.

categories.name: Body Posture
categories.description: A sustained body configuration. The historical broad posture transition entry is retained as a process, with its own boundary rule; specific transitions belong in Locomotion.
categories.evidence_mode: video / BVH posture
categories.boundary_rule: Start when the stated configuration is established; end when it clearly ceases. Exclude the transition into and out of the posture.

categories.name: Hand Behavior
categories.description: Visible hand shape, inter-hand arrangement, placement, self-contact, self-support posture or repetitive hand action. Choose the most specific supported description of one relation; its broad and fine labels are alternatives, not duplicate events. Record object relations in HOI and interpersonal contact in Physical Interaction.
categories.evidence_mode: close video; BVH only if fingers/contact are supported
categories.boundary_rule: Start when the stated hand arrangement or action is visible; end when it breaks or changes. Split repeated bouts at a clear pause and use not visible for missing evidence.

categories.name: Locomotion
categories.description: Whole-body displacement, stepping, weight transfer and transitions between standing, sitting, squatting and kneeling.
categories.evidence_mode: video / root and lower-body kinematics
categories.boundary_rule: Start at the first clear locomotor movement or weight transfer; end when it stops or another locomotor pattern begins. Annotate stationary as a sustained state, not a missing detection.

categories.name: Whole-body Action
categories.description: A complete observable whole-body action or balance event. Local primitives, sustained posture and interpersonal roles remain independently annotatable.
categories.evidence_mode: synchronized video / body kinematics; support evidence where required
categories.boundary_rule: Mark the complete action from its first discriminating movement to completion or a clear change. Use each label boundary rule; do not extend into the subsequent held posture.
categories.boundary_rule_zh: 标从首个可辨认动作到完成或明确改变的完整过程；使用各标签专用边界，不延伸到其后保持的姿态。

categories.name: Gait Pattern
categories.description: Observable gait quality during a locomotor bout, independent of travel direction, cause, diagnosis and emotion.
categories.evidence_mode: video / successive lower-limb and root kinematics with valid tracking
categories.boundary_rule: Mark the part of the locomotor bout in which the gait feature is consistently observable. End on a clear pattern change or loss of usable evidence.
categories.boundary_rule_zh: 标步行或移动中该步态特征持续可观察的区间；在特征改变或证据不可用时结束。

categories.name: Gesture Type
categories.description: A contextual interpretation of an observable communicative gesture; phase and speech relation are separate types.
categories.evidence_mode: video with conversation context
categories.boundary_rule: Mark one gesture unit from visible preparation through its final retraction, when present. Split independently interpretable gestures; do not extend a unit across an unrelated pause.

categories.name: Gesture Phase
categories.description: Temporal components within a gesture unit: preparation, expressive stroke, hold and retraction.
categories.evidence_mode: video / BVH, interpreted within a gesture unit
categories.boundary_rule: Use the onset and offset of the particular phase, not the entire gesture unit. Boundaries must follow visible changes of phase; do not manufacture phases that are absent.

categories.name: Speech-Gesture Relation
categories.description: Whether a gesture is coordinated with speech by the same actor; no listener role is assigned.
categories.evidence_mode: synchronized audio and video
categories.boundary_rule: Use the gesture unit as the interval and inspect the surrounding speech. Temporal overlap alone is not sufficient for a semantic relation.

categories.name: Action / HOI
categories.description: Observable object actions and sustained contact or support relations; identify the body part and stable object instance separately.
categories.evidence_mode: video with visible object/contact; optional calibrated body and object geometry
categories.boundary_rule: For an action, mark the operation from onset to completion. For a state, mark the full maintained relation from establishment to separation or change. Speech boundaries do not split an otherwise continuous state.

categories.name: Speaking
categories.description: Audible speech activity and speech-quality qualifiers for an assigned actor or an unknown speaker.
categories.evidence_mode: audio; video may help assign an actor
categories.boundary_rule: Start at audible speech onset and end at speech offset. Keep overlaps where both actors are audible; do not assign an identity or listener status from silence.

categories.name: Speech Turn
categories.description: An actor-specific conversational turn that may include short internal pauses; automatic grouping is a candidate based on attributed speech.
categories.evidence_mode: attributed speech intervals, audio and conversation context
categories.boundary_rule: Begin at the first contribution taking or claiming the turn; end when the turn is yielded or abandoned. Preserve a turn across its internal pauses and verified backchannels where supported by context.

categories.name: Turn Transition
categories.description: A timestamped speaker-change candidate or reviewed floor-transfer relation, linked to the contributing turns when available.
categories.evidence_mode: source speech turns and conversational context
categories.boundary_rule: Place a point at the incoming contribution onset under this project convention. Preserve the outgoing end and source turn IDs separately; a point does not claim a measurable transition duration.

categories.name: Speech Timing
categories.description: Positive-duration timing intervals derived from speech or turn boundaries; derived timing does not by itself establish conversational function.
categories.evidence_mode: attributed speech intervals and source turn intervals
categories.boundary_rule: Use the exact intersection or gap between the relevant source boundaries. Do not inflate zero-duration boundaries into spans; use a Turn Transition point for a boundary event.

categories.name: Speech Disfluency
categories.description: Observable disruptions in speech production such as filled pauses, repetition, cut-offs and self-correction. Ordinary silent timing intervals remain in Speech Timing.
categories.evidence_mode: audio with optional checked transcript; speaker attribution must be explicit
categories.boundary_rule: Mark the audible disfluent material and, where specified, its immediate repair. Keep surrounding ordinary pauses in Speech Timing; disfluency alone does not establish hesitation or affect.
categories.boundary_rule_zh: 标可听见的不流利成分及定义要求的紧接修正；普通静默另在 Speech Timing 标注，不由不流利直接推断犹豫或情绪。

categories.name: Vocal Event
categories.description: Audible non-lexical vocal sounds, independent of dialogue function or inferred emotion.
categories.evidence_mode: audio
categories.boundary_rule: Start at the first audible part of the vocal event and end at its acoustic offset. Review short model windows by listening; do not include the surrounding silence.

categories.name: Audio Activity
categories.description: Signal-energy activity or unavailable audio; this type does not classify speech or vocal events.
categories.evidence_mode: audio / waveform
categories.boundary_rule: Mark the interval of audible or detected activity, or the interval with missing usable audio. An energy event may contain noise rather than human vocalization.

categories.name: Dialogue Event
categories.description: Contextual turn-taking actions and conversational functions, separate from acoustic sound classes.
categories.evidence_mode: audio and conversational context
categories.boundary_rule: Mark the utterance or brief exchange that performs the function. For directed events, assign initiator and target only when supported by context.

categories.name: Proxemic Movement
categories.description: Actor-specific changes in distance or body orientation relative to a partner; no social intention is implied.
categories.evidence_mode: video / calibrated root and torso motion
categories.boundary_rule: Start when the selected actor clearly begins the relative translation or turn; end when it stops or reverses. Pair distance alone cannot identify which actor moved.

categories.name: Spatial Configuration
categories.description: A sustained relative position and body-facing arrangement of the pair, separate from movement and interaction function.
categories.evidence_mode: video / calibrated positions and body orientation
categories.boundary_rule: Start when the arrangement is established; end when either participant changes it. Use a consistent project-specific orientation tolerance; do not infer eye gaze from body facing.

categories.name: Object Spatial Relation
categories.evidence_mode: Manual observation relative to a named object or region. No mesh, prop trajectory or geometric model is required.
categories.description: Whole-person position relative to one or two registered named objects or regions, independent of contact, support and social meaning.
categories.description_zh: 人物整体相对于一个或两个已命名物体／区域的位置，区别于接触、支撑及社会含义。
categories.boundary_rule: Mark the interval in which the actor occupies the stated position relative to the named target. End when that relation changes or cannot be judged. Use a consistent whole-person position reference; a reaching hand alone does not move the person into a new region.
categories.boundary_rule_zh: 标人物整体与所选物体的关系成立的区间，在关系改变或无法判断时结束。人物位置使用一致的身体／地面参照，不因一只手伸过去就改变整个人的位置标签。

categories.name: Object-relative Movement
categories.evidence_mode: Manual observation relative to a named object or region. No mesh, prop trajectory or geometric model is required.
categories.description: Actor movement relative to a registered named object or region. Target identity does not require a 3D model.
categories.description_zh: 人物相对于已命名物体或区域的移动，无需物体三维模型即可人工标注。
categories.boundary_rule: Start at the actor movement that establishes the named relative change; end at completion, a clear stop or a change of movement. A moving target alone does not establish actor movement. Exclude the subsequent held spatial state.
categories.boundary_rule_zh: 从人物产生所述相对变化的运动开始，到完成、明确停止或运动改变结束；物体单独移动不算人物的该项运动，不包含随后保持的位置状态。

categories.name: Interaction Event
categories.description: A social action or exchange supported by context, distinct from proximity, simultaneous movement and dialogue acoustics.
categories.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context
categories.boundary_rule: Start at the first action constituting the event; end when it resolves or clearly ceases. Separate initiative and response when actor direction matters; record target and supporting cues.

categories.name: Physical Interaction
categories.description: Observable bodily contact, support or physically directed action between people. A directed record identifies initiator/helper and recipient; a pair record is reserved for a genuinely mutual description.
categories.evidence_mode: video with visible interpersonal action/contact; calibrated geometry may assist
categories.boundary_rule: Mark the observed interpersonal action or maintained relation. Separate an attempted action from its outcome and do not infer contact from distance alone.
categories.boundary_rule_zh: 标可观察的对人动作或持续身体关系；尝试与结果分开记录，不由距离接近推断接触。

categories.name: Cognitive State Expression
categories.description: An expressed or visibly displayed cognitive/appraisal state, attributed to an actor with evidence and optional target. Script intent and private mental state are separate records.
categories.evidence_mode: audible utterances / observable behavior and interaction context; note the evidence source
categories.boundary_rule: Mark only the contribution or behavioral episode supporting the interpretation. Do not propagate a hidden state through silent or unobserved time.
categories.boundary_rule_zh: 只标支持该解释的话语或行为片段；不把隐藏心理状态延伸到静默或不可观察区间。

categories.name: Perceived Affect
categories.description: A cautious observer impression from multimodal context, not a verified internal emotion or a facial-action classifier.
categories.evidence_mode: multimodal context reviewed by a human
categories.boundary_rule: Mark only the interval with supporting cues. End when the impression changes or evidence becomes insufficient; record the cues and uncertainty in notes.

categories.name: QC / Notes
categories.description: Data quality, visibility, alignment and annotation issues; these are not observed participant behaviors.
categories.evidence_mode: all available modalities / project metadata
categories.boundary_rule: Mark the interval affected by the problem. Start when evidence becomes unreliable and end when it recovers; describe the affected modality and uncertainty in notes.

labels.description_en: The actor visibly pushes a wheeled cart. Record posture, direction or other observable details in the description.

labels.description_en: The right hand shows an observable back-and-forth waving pattern in position or orientation, with alternating sweeps and direction reversals. The wrist, forearm or whole arm may contribute. This describes movement form only; greeting, farewell, refusal or intended recipient are not inferred.
labels.description_zh: 右手的位置或朝向呈可见往复挥动，具有交替摆动和方向反转；腕、前臂或整臂可参与，不推断问候、告别、拒绝或对象。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first sweep belonging to the observed back-and-forth bout; end at the last sweep before a clear stop or change of movement form. A single unidirectional reach is not this pattern. Choose the primary observed moving part (hand or same-side arm) for one annotation; do not duplicate the same bout merely because both parts participate.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从属于该往复动作段的第一次摆动开始，到明确停止或运动形式改变前的最后一次摆动结束。单次单向前伸不属于此模式。选择主要被观察的运动部位（手或同侧手臂）记录一次，不因两者参与而重复标注。
labels.auto_method: No waving detector is implemented in this release. A future rule may use body-relative hand trajectory/orientation and repeated reversals with explicit amplitude, duration and repetition criteria. Current generic arm/hand movement proposals do not classify waving.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the directional head movement from its first clear departure until it stops or reverses. Use actor-relative head-to-torso orientation, not screen direction; exclude the subsequent held posture. Use the broad head label when the direction cannot be resolved.

labels.boundary_rule_en: Select the moving arm track. Start at the first lateral upper-arm change and end when it stops or reverses; exclude the held end position. Use actor-relative direction, and do not duplicate the same movement under a broad arm label when a specific label is sufficient.

labels.boundary_rule_en: Select the moving hand track. Start at the first clear hand-shape or wrist-angle change of the specified form; end when it stops or reverses. labels.boundary_rule_zh: 选择发生运动的腿部轨道。从指定形式的首次明确运动开始，到停止或反向结束，排除终点保持姿态。使用人物自身的骨盆／腿部几何，选择证据支持的最具体标签，不与其较宽替代项重复计数。
labels.auto_method: No leg-lift, hip flexion/extension or outward/inward leg detector is implemented in this release. Future rules require validated pelvis/leg axes and joint geometry; existing coarse leg activity cannot establish the mechanism.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: The selected thigh moves posteriorly relative to the pelvis, including returning from a flexed hip toward neutral. This does not mean knee straightening or generic lowering of the leg.
labels.description_zh: 所选侧大腿相对骨盆向后运动，也包括从屈髋回到中立；不是伸膝，也不等于所有放腿动作。

labels.description_en: The selected thigh or leg moves laterally away from the actor midline relative to the pelvis. Distinguish this hip-level outward form from whole-body translation or rotation of the camera.
labels.description_zh: 所选侧大腿／腿相对骨盆向身体中线外侧移动；区别于全身平移、镜头变化或单纯转向。

labels.description_zh: 所选侧大腿／腿从外侧向身体中线收回，不要求最终与另一条腿接触。

labels.description_en: The spatial separation of the legs increases through movement of one or both legs. This coarse bilateral pattern does not establish a front split, middle split, pure hip abduction or contact.
labels.description_zh: 一条或两条腿运动使双腿间距增大；这是粗略双腿模式，不直接证明前后劈叉、横叉、纯髋外展或接触。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Use Full Body for the combined bilateral observation, or the primarily moving leg when only that side is being analysed. Mark separation change from onset to cessation. Do not duplicate the same bout on both legs and Full Body; do not include the held configuration.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 双腿整体观察使用 Full Body；只分析一侧时选择主要运动腿。从腿间距离开始改变标到改变停止。不在双腿与 Full Body 上重复标同一动作段，也不纳入随后保持的形态。
labels.auto_method: No bilateral leg-separation detector is implemented in this release. A future rule may measure validated body-relative leg separation, but cannot infer a split posture from separation alone.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: The spatial separation of the legs decreases through movement of one or both legs. Contact between legs is not required, and the maintained legs-together posture is a separate state.
labels.description_zh: 一条或两条腿运动使双腿间距减小，不要求腿部接触；与之后持续并腿姿态分开。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Use Full Body for the combined bilateral observation, or the primarily moving leg when only that side is being analysed. Mark separation change from onset to cessation. Do not duplicate the same bout on both legs and Full Body; do not include the held configuration.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 双腿整体观察使用 Full Body；只分析一侧时选择主要运动腿。从腿间距离开始改变标到改变停止。不在双腿与 Full Body 上重复标同一动作段，也不纳入随后保持的形态。
labels.auto_method: No bilateral leg-separation detector is implemented in this release. A future rule may measure validated body-relative leg separation, but cannot infer a split posture from separation alone.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: The right knee undergoes flexion, changing the relative angle of the thigh and shank. Translation or rotation of the entire leg without this knee-angle change is insufficient. This local joint movement may occur within a larger action such as squatting or kicking.
labels.description_zh: 右膝发生屈曲，大腿与小腿的相对角度改变；整腿平移不能替代膝关节证据，可发生于下蹲或踢腿等较大动作之中。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first clear flexion of the selected knee; end when it stops or reverses. Exclude a subsequent held bent or straight position. Use a valid hip-knee-ankle mapping or visible joint movement, not a raw Euler-channel sign or whole-leg displacement.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从所选膝关节首次明确屈曲开始，到停止或反向结束。排除随后保持的屈膝或伸直姿态。需有效的髋—膝—踝映射或可见关节运动，不能用原始欧拉通道符号或整腿位移替代。
labels.auto_method: BVH thigh / shank angle change, split at stops or reversals. Review the result.
labels.evidence_mode: visible knee movement or validated hip / knee / ankle kinematics

labels.description_en: The right knee undergoes extension, changing the relative angle of the thigh and shank. Translation or rotation of the entire leg without this knee-angle change is insufficient. This local joint movement may occur within a larger action such as squatting or kicking.
labels.description_zh: 右膝逐渐伸直，大腿与小腿的相对角度改变；标注伸直过程，不包含之后保持伸直的姿态。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first clear extension of the selected knee; end when it stops or reverses. Exclude a subsequent held bent or straight position. Use a valid hip-knee-ankle mapping or visible joint movement, not a raw Euler-channel sign or whole-leg displacement.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从所选膝关节首次明确伸展开始，到停止或反向结束。排除随后保持的屈膝或伸直姿态。需有效的髋—膝—踝映射或可见关节运动，不能用原始欧拉通道符号或整腿位移替代。
labels.auto_method: BVH thigh / shank angle change, split at stops or reversals. Review the result.
labels.evidence_mode: visible knee movement or validated hip / knee / ankle kinematics

labels.description_en: The right leg or foot makes a distinct projecting swing or thrust. This is a coarser movement pattern that may combine hip and knee motion, not a strictly atomic joint primitive. A target, contact, aggression or communicative intention is not inferred; ordinary stepping or undifferentiated leg motion is insufficient.
labels.description_zh: 右腿或右脚呈明确的向外摆出或踢动模式；这是可含髋膝联合运动的较粗运动模式，不是严格单关节原子，不推断目标、碰撞、攻击或交际意图。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first movement belonging to the distinct projecting bout; end when the thrust and any immediately connected retraction finish. Split separate kicks at a clear pause or new bout. Do not extend the event through a subsequently held leg posture.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从属于这次明显伸踢动作段的首个动作开始，到伸踢及紧接的回收完成结束。明确停顿或新动作段之间分开记录，不把之后保持的腿姿纳入。
labels.auto_method: No kicking detector is implemented in this release. A future kinematic rule needs body-relative leg/foot trajectory and validated joint motion; coarse leg activity is not a kicking classification and cannot establish an object strike.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: One or both legs move across the other leg into a crossed arrangement. This is the crossing movement, not the maintained legs-crossed posture or an ordinary passing of the legs during walking.
labels.description_zh: 一条或两条腿移入交叉配置的过程，区别于之后持续的双腿交叉姿态；选择主要运动腿，不因涉及双腿而自动重复标注。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the moving leg departs toward the crossing; end when the crossed arrangement is established or the crossing movement clearly stops. Select the primarily moving leg. Do not duplicate the same bout on both leg tracks merely because both legs define the relation; use Full Body for a combined observation when appropriate.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从运动腿开始向交叉位置移动，到交叉排列建立或交叉运动明确停止结束。选择主要运动腿，不因双腿共同定义关系而在两条腿轨道重复标注；需要整体观察时使用 Full Body。
labels.auto_method: No leg crossing/uncrossing detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires body-relative leg trajectories and configuration evidence. Existing leg activity does not establish crossing, sustained posture or physical contact.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: One or both legs move out of an established crossed arrangement. This is the release movement, not the subsequent uncrossed posture.
labels.description_zh: 一条或两条腿离开已建立交叉配置的过程，区别于之后不交叉的持续姿态；选择主要运动腿。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when a leg leaves the established crossed arrangement; end when the uncrossing movement stops or reaches the next maintained posture. Select the primarily moving leg. Do not duplicate the same bout on both leg tracks merely because both legs define the relation; use Full Body for a combined observation when appropriate.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从一条腿离开已建立的交叉排列开始，到解开交叉的运动停止或进入下一保持姿态结束。选择主要运动腿，不因双腿共同定义关系而重复记录；需要整体观察时使用 Full Body。

labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: The relevant body part cannot be assessed from the available evidence.
labels.description_zh: 所需身体部位或其运动缺少足够可用证据，无法判断。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the relevant body part or action can no longer be assessed; end when sufficient usable evidence returns. Do not infer behavior within the obscured interval.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从相关身体部位或动作无法评估时开始，到足够的可用证据恢复时结束；不推断被遮挡区间内的行为。

labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_zh: 所选足在踝关节处向小腿前侧靠拢，整腿抬起不能替代踝部证据。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first sustained movement in the stated direction; end at a clear stop, reversal or change of form. Exclude the subsequently held configuration.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从所述方向的明确运动开始，在停止、反向或形式改变时结束，不包含随后保持的姿态。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this new label is implemented. Future candidates require validated body mapping, geometry or signal rules and review on representative data.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: The selected foot rotates away from the shin at the ankle, as in pointing the foot.
labels.description_zh: 所选足在踝关节处远离小腿前侧转动，呈绷脚方向。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first sustained movement in the stated direction; end at a clear stop, reversal or change of form. Exclude the subsequently held configuration.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从所述方向的明确运动开始，在停止、反向或形式改变时结束，不包含随后保持的姿态。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this new label is implemented. Future candidates require validated body mapping, geometry or signal rules and review on representative data.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: The selected sole turns inward relative to the lower leg, when foot orientation is resolved.
labels.description_zh: 在足朝向可辨认时，所选足底相对小腿向内侧翻转。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first sustained movement in the stated direction; end at a clear stop, reversal or change of form. Exclude the subsequently held configuration.

labels.auto_method: No detector for this new label is implemented. Future candidates require validated body mapping, geometry or signal rules and review on representative data.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: The selected sole turns outward relative to the lower leg, when foot orientation is resolved.
labels.description_zh: 在足朝向可辨认时，所选足底相对小腿向外侧翻转。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first sustained movement in the stated direction; end at a clear stop, reversal or change of form. Exclude the subsequently held configuration.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从所述方向的明确运动开始，在停止、反向或形式改变时结束，不包含随后保持的姿态。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this new label is implemented. Future candidates require validated body mapping, geometry or signal rules and review on representative data.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: A repeated small foot-lift and return pattern is visible; impact sound, nervousness and impatience are not inferred.
labels.description_zh: 可见脚部反复小幅抬起与回落，不推断敲击声音、紧张或不耐烦。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the repeated tapping bout from first to last observed cycle, ending at a clear pause or pattern change.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从第一轮到最后一轮标完整反复轻点段，在明确停顿或模式改变时结束。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this new label is implemented. Future candidates require validated body mapping, geometry or signal rules and review on representative data.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: The hand moves away from the torso as the arm extends in any direction.
labels.description_zh: 手臂伸展使手远离躯干，方向不限。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark outward extension from departure to a stop or reversal. Use a specific forward reach when its direction is clear; mark isolated elbow straightening separately.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从手开始远离躯干标到停下或反向。明确向前伸手时可用向前伸手；单独的肘伸展用伸直肘。
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: The hand traces a circular path relative to the forearm through combined wrist flexion, extension and deviation.
labels.description_zh: 手相对前臂通过腕屈伸和侧偏做绕环运动。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the observable circle or continuous series. Exclude rotation of the whole forearm and isolated wrist flexion or deviation.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从可见绕环开始标到该次或连续一组绕环结束；排除整段前臂旋转和单独的腕屈伸或侧偏。
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: The pelvis shifts relative to the actor’s established support during a local movement.
labels.description_zh: 在局部动作中，骨盆相对人物已建立的支撑位置发生平移。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the clear shift from onset to stop or reversal. Use Locomotion for travel or a change of support during stepping.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从可辨识的骨盆平移开始标到停下或反向；行进或迈步时的支撑转换用 Locomotion。
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH kinematics

labels.description_en: The actor maintains an upright posture supported primarily by the feet.
labels.description_zh: 身体保持直立，主要由双脚或单脚支撑。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the stated configuration is established; end when it clearly ceases. Exclude the transition into and out of the posture.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从姿态建立到其明确结束，排除进入和离开姿态的转换过程；历史 posture transition 项仍为过程，使用其专用边界。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this label is implemented in this release. The intended workflow uses explicit geometric or signal rules, followed by task-appropriate review.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH posture

labels.description_en: The actor maintains a seated posture with support under the pelvis.
labels.description_zh: 身体保持坐姿，骨盆下方有支撑；具体支撑物体由 HOI 关系记录。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the stated configuration is established; end when it clearly ceases. Exclude the transition into and out of the posture.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从姿态建立到其明确结束，排除进入和离开姿态的转换过程；历史 posture transition 项仍为过程，使用其专用边界。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this label is implemented in this release. The intended workflow uses explicit geometric or signal rules, followed by task-appropriate review.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH posture

labels.description_en: The actor maintains a lowered body configuration with flexed hips and knees and support primarily through the feet. Distinguish it from seated or kneeling support; the movement into or out of the configuration is a separate transition.
labels.description_zh: 髋膝弯曲、身体降低且主要由脚支撑的持续蹲姿；区别于坐姿或跪姿，也区别于下蹲和起身的转换过程。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the squat configuration is established and maintained; end when the actor clearly leaves it. Exclude lowering into the squat and rising from it. Use posture uncertain when support or configuration cannot be distinguished.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从蹲姿建立并保持开始，到人物明确离开蹲姿结束。排除降低进入与起身离开的过程；支撑或形态无法区分时用姿态不确定。
labels.auto_method: No squatting-posture detector is implemented in this release. A future rule needs validated lower-body joint geometry and support evidence; root height alone is insufficient.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH posture

labels.description_en: The actor maintains a posture with one or both knees visibly contacting a support surface in a kneeling support configuration. Knee-to-floor proximity in BVH alone does not establish contact, support or force. Record uncertainty when the support relation is not observable.
labels.description_zh: 一侧或双侧膝与支撑面有可见接触并形成跪姿支撑配置；BVH 中膝靠近地面不足以证明接触、承重或力值，证据不足时保留姿态不确定。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the kneeling configuration and knee support/contact are established; end when that configuration ceases. Exclude kneeling down and rising. If knee contact is occluded or unsupported by reliable evidence, use posture uncertain rather than assuming contact from joint height.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从跪姿及膝部支撑／接触建立开始，到该形态解除结束，排除跪下与起身过程。膝接触被遮挡或缺乏可靠证据时用姿态不确定，不凭关节高度假定接触。
labels.auto_method: No kneeling-posture detector is implemented in this release. A future rule may propose candidates from validated lower-body geometry; visible or independently established knee support/contact must be checked, without inferring force.
labels.evidence_mode: video showing knee/support relation; BVH geometry alone cannot establish contact

labels.description_en: The actor maintains a recumbent configuration with the torso broadly supported rather than upright. Use this broad label when lying is clear but the more specific supported body side is not classified. Sleeping, comfort and the identity of a support object are not inferred.
labels.description_zh: 身体保持躺卧、躯干得到较广泛支撑而非直立的配置；侧别未细分时用此项，不推断睡眠、舒适或具体支撑物。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the maintained lying configuration is established; end when it ceases or changes to a different classified orientation. Exclude lying down, getting up and rolling transitions. Prefer a supported specific lying label over also recording generic lying for the same phenomenon. The identified support object belongs in HOI.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从保持的卧姿建立开始，到其解除或转为另一种已分类朝向结束。排除躺下、起身和翻滚转换。已有证据支持具体卧姿时，不再为同一现象重复记录一般卧姿；已知支撑物体属于 HOI。
labels.auto_method: No lying-posture detector is implemented in this release. A future geometry rule can propose candidates, but support/orientation evidence must be reviewed; low root height alone does not establish lying.
labels.evidence_mode: video showing recumbent body configuration and support; calibrated body geometry as an aid

labels.description_en: The actor maintains a lying posture with the back side of the torso facing the support surface and the front side facing away. Judge body orientation relative to support, not the camera; do not infer sleep.
labels.description_zh: 保持背侧朝向支撑面、身体前侧朝外的仰卧配置；按身体与支撑关系判断，不按镜头方向，也不推断睡眠。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the maintained lying configuration is established; end when it ceases or changes to a different classified orientation. Exclude lying down, getting up and rolling transitions. Prefer a supported specific lying label over also recording generic lying for the same phenomenon. The identified support object belongs in HOI.

labels.auto_method: No lying-posture detector is implemented in this release. A future geometry rule can propose candidates, but support/orientation evidence must be reviewed; low root height alone does not establish lying.
labels.evidence_mode: video showing recumbent body configuration and support; calibrated body geometry as an aid

labels.description_en: The actor maintains a lying posture with the front side of the torso facing the support surface. Head rotation can differ and is recorded separately; do not infer sleep or discomfort.
labels.description_zh: 保持躯干前侧朝向支撑面的俯卧配置；头可另行转向，不推断睡眠或不适。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the maintained lying configuration is established; end when it ceases or changes to a different classified orientation. Exclude lying down, getting up and rolling transitions. Prefer a supported specific lying label over also recording generic lying for the same phenomenon. The identified support object belongs in HOI.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从保持的卧姿建立开始，到其解除或转为另一种已分类朝向结束。排除躺下、起身和翻滚转换。已有证据支持具体卧姿时，不再为同一现象重复记录一般卧姿；已知支撑物体属于 HOI。

labels.evidence_mode: video showing recumbent body configuration and support; calibrated body geometry as an aid

labels.description_en: The actor maintains a lying posture with the left side of the trunk toward the supporting surface. Left is anatomical, not screen-left; use the broad lying label if the supported side is not observable.
labels.description_zh: 保持本人躯干左侧朝向支撑面的侧卧配置；左侧指解剖侧别，不能按画面左侧判断。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the maintained lying configuration is established; end when it ceases or changes to a different classified orientation. Exclude lying down, getting up and rolling transitions. Prefer a supported specific lying label over also recording generic lying for the same phenomenon. The identified support object belongs in HOI.

labels.evidence_mode: video showing recumbent body configuration and support; calibrated body geometry as an aid

labels.description_en: The actor maintains a lying posture with the right side of the trunk toward the supporting surface. Right is anatomical, not screen-right; use the broad lying label if the supported side is not observable.
labels.description_zh: 保持本人躯干右侧朝向支撑面的侧卧配置；右侧指解剖侧别，不能按画面右侧判断。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the maintained lying configuration is established; end when it ceases or changes to a different classified orientation. Exclude lying down, getting up and rolling transitions. Prefer a supported specific lying label over also recording generic lying for the same phenomenon. The identified support object belongs in HOI.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从保持的卧姿建立开始，到其解除或转为另一种已分类朝向结束。排除躺下、起身和翻滚转换。已有证据支持具体卧姿时，不再为同一现象重复记录一般卧姿；已知支撑物体属于 HOI。

labels.evidence_mode: video showing recumbent body configuration and support; calibrated body geometry as an aid

labels.description_en: The actor maintains one knee on a support surface while the opposite leg is placed forward with its foot on a support surface. This specific kneeling configuration requires observable knee and foot support relations; low joint height alone is insufficient.
labels.description_zh: 一侧膝接触支撑面，另一侧腿在前且脚接触支撑面的持续半跪配置；需可观察接触／支撑，不能只看关节高度。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the one-knee/other-foot configuration is established; end when it changes. Exclude the transition into or out of the posture. Prefer this specific label over generic kneeling for the same configuration; record the grounded knee side in the track or notes when known.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从一膝与另一足支撑的形态建立开始，到该形态改变结束，排除进出姿态的转换。对同一形态优先用本具体标签而非再标一般跪姿；已知时在轨道或备注说明着地膝的侧别。
labels.auto_method: No half-kneeling detector is implemented in this release. Geometry can only suggest the configuration; reliable contact/support evidence is needed and forces are not measured.
labels.evidence_mode: visible knee and opposite-foot support relations; validated geometry may aid review

labels.description_en: The actor maintains an upright posture with primary foot support through the left leg while the other foot is visibly off the supporting surface. Additional hand or object support may be recorded separately; balance ability, load and force are not inferred.
labels.description_zh: 保持直立，主要脚部支撑来自左腿，另一只脚明确离开支撑面；额外手部或物体支撑可另记，不推断平衡能力或力值。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the single-leg standing configuration is established; end when it changes or the other foot returns to support. Exclude weight-transfer transitions. Prefer this specific posture over also recording generic standing for the same phenomenon.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从单腿站立形态建立开始，到形态改变或另一足重新参与支撑结束，排除重心转移过程。对同一现象优先使用本具体姿态，不再重复记录一般站立。
labels.auto_method: No single-leg-standing detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires posture and foot/support evidence; foot height alone cannot determine actual load bearing.
labels.evidence_mode: video showing foot/support relationship; calibrated whole-body geometry as an aid

labels.description_en: The actor maintains an upright posture with primary foot support through the right leg while the other foot is visibly off the supporting surface. Additional hand or object support may be recorded separately; balance ability, load and force are not inferred.
labels.description_zh: 保持直立，主要脚部支撑来自右腿，另一只脚明确离开支撑面；额外手部或物体支撑可另记，不推断平衡能力或力值。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the single-leg standing configuration is established; end when it changes or the other foot returns to support. Exclude weight-transfer transitions. Prefer this specific posture over also recording generic standing for the same phenomenon.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从单腿站立形态建立开始，到形态改变或另一足重新参与支撑结束，排除重心转移过程。对同一现象优先使用本具体姿态，不再重复记录一般站立。
labels.auto_method: No single-leg-standing detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires posture and foot/support evidence; foot height alone cannot determine actual load bearing.
labels.evidence_mode: video showing foot/support relationship; calibrated whole-body geometry as an aid

labels.description_en: The actor maintains visibly separated legs relative to the pelvis under the project spacing criterion. This broad configuration can occur while sitting or standing and does not establish a front split, middle split or a particular social meaning.
labels.description_zh: 双腿相对骨盆保持明显分开的配置，可出现在坐姿或站姿；不直接等于劈叉、横叉或某种社会含义。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the specified spacing configuration is established and maintained; end when it changes. Exclude the separating or closing motion. Use a consistent body-scaled spacing criterion, not image pixel distance; choose a specific split label when supported.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从所述腿间距离形态建立并保持开始，到其改变结束，排除分开或合拢运动。采用一致的身体尺度相对标准，不用图像像素距离；有依据时选择具体劈叉标签。
labels.auto_method: No leg-spacing posture detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires calibrated body-relative configuration and project-specific spacing criteria.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH posture

labels.description_en: The actor maintains the legs close together relative to the pelvis under the project spacing criterion. Physical contact is not required or inferred; this describes configuration rather than the movement of bringing the legs together.
labels.description_zh: 双腿相对骨盆保持接近／并拢配置，按项目统一间距准则判断；不要求或推断双腿接触。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the specified spacing configuration is established and maintained; end when it changes. Exclude the separating or closing motion. Use a consistent body-scaled spacing criterion, not image pixel distance; choose a specific split label when supported.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从所述腿间距离形态建立并保持开始，到其改变结束，排除分开或合拢运动。采用一致的身体尺度相对标准，不用图像像素距离；有依据时选择具体劈叉标签。
labels.auto_method: No leg-spacing posture detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires calibrated body-relative configuration and project-specific spacing criteria.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH posture

labels.description_en: The actor maintains a low split configuration with one leg extended forward and the other backward relative to the pelvis, approaching opposed alignment in the actor sagittal plane. Ordinary separated legs, a step or a bent-knee lunge are insufficient; do not infer flexibility limits or support force.
labels.description_zh: 保持一腿相对骨盆前伸、另一腿后伸，骨盆较低、双腿接近前后相反直线的劈叉配置；普通分腿、迈步或弯膝弓步不足以成立。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the specified maintained split configuration is established; end when it ceases. Exclude entering or leaving the split. Apply the project-defined hip/knee geometry tolerance; if only leg separation is supported, use legs apart rather than claiming a split.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从所述劈叉形态建立并保持开始，到其解除结束，排除进入和离开过程。使用项目定义的髋／膝几何容差；若只能确定腿分开，则用 legs apart，不认定为劈叉。
labels.auto_method: No front/middle-split posture detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires reliable pelvis/leg geometry, knee configuration and explicit posture criteria; leg distance alone is insufficient.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH posture

labels.description_en: The actor maintains a low split configuration with both legs extended laterally to opposite sides of the pelvis, approaching opposed alignment in the actor frontal plane. An ordinary wide stance or separated seated knees are insufficient; do not infer flexibility limits or force.
labels.description_zh: 保持双腿相对骨盆向两侧伸展、骨盆较低、双腿接近左右相反直线的横叉配置；普通宽站姿或坐姿膝分开不足以成立。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the specified maintained split configuration is established; end when it ceases. Exclude entering or leaving the split. Apply the project-defined hip/knee geometry tolerance; if only leg separation is supported, use legs apart rather than claiming a split.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从所述劈叉形态建立并保持开始，到其解除结束，排除进入和离开过程。使用项目定义的髋／膝几何容差；若只能确定腿分开，则用 legs apart，不认定为劈叉。
labels.auto_method: No front/middle-split posture detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires reliable pelvis/leg geometry, knee configuration and explicit posture criteria; leg distance alone is insufficient.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH posture

labels.description_en: The head remains near neutral alignment relative to the upper torso without a marked forward/back tilt, lateral tilt or turn under the project tolerance. This body-relative state does not determine world-vertical orientation or eye gaze.
labels.description_zh: 头相对上躯干保持接近中立，无明显俯仰、侧倾或转头；这是身体相对配置，不要求世界坐标竖直，也不判断注视。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the head configuration is established and maintained; end when it leaves the project-defined orientation tolerance. Exclude the movement into and out of it. Judge head-to-torso axes in the actor frame, not camera direction; do not infer gaze.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从头部形态建立并保持开始，到超出项目朝向容差结束，排除进入和离开的运动。按人物自身的头—躯干相对轴判断，不用相机方向，也不推断眼睛注视。
labels.auto_method: No specific head-posture detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires validated head/torso axes and an explicit sustained-orientation tolerance.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH posture

labels.description_en: The head remains flexed forward relative to the upper torso. This is a maintained configuration after head flexion; it does not establish looking downward or attention to an object.
labels.description_zh: 头相对上躯干保持前屈；与低头过程分开，不据此认定眼睛向下看或注意某物。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the head configuration is established and maintained; end when it leaves the project-defined orientation tolerance. Exclude the movement into and out of it. Judge head-to-torso axes in the actor frame, not camera direction; do not infer gaze.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从头部形态建立并保持开始，到超出项目朝向容差结束，排除进入和离开的运动。按人物自身的头—躯干相对轴判断，不用相机方向，也不推断眼睛注视。
labels.auto_method: No specific head-posture detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires validated head/torso axes and an explicit sustained-orientation tolerance.
labels.evidence_mode: video / BVH posture

labels.description_en: The head remains extended backward relative to the upper torso. It does not establish upward eye gaze, attention or a particular emotion.
labels.description_zh: 头相对上躯干保持后伸／后仰；不据此判断眼睛向上看、注意或情绪。

labels.description_zh: 所选手在本人下巴近下方保持，并可见间隙；手位于更低的其他位置不足以成立。这是保持的位置关系，不包括移入过程。看不清间隙或接触时保留不确定，不把遮挡解释为未接触。

labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从移入后近下方且分离的位置关系建立开始，到位置改变、间隙消失或分离证据不可用时结束；不因保持同一关系的轻微调整而拆段。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this label is connected. Manual selection is available; future model assistance requires integration and evaluation. Spatial proximity alone must not be accepted as contact or self-support.
labels.evidence_mode: Video resolving the selected hand and the actor's own chin/cheek. Visible separation supports placement; contact and resting require their own visible evidence. BVH proximity alone cannot confirm contact or support, and no support force or internal state is measured.

labels.description_en: The selected hand visibly touches or remains against the actor's own chin. Approaching the chin alone is insufficient. Use this contact description when a more specific resting relation is not established; do not also count self-touch or hand to face for the same observation.
labels.description_zh: 所选手可见地触及或贴住本人的下巴，仅靠近不足以成立。接触明确但不能进一步确认托下巴姿态时使用；同一观察不再额外计为自我触碰或手部触脸。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at visible chin contact, excluding approach. End at separation, a clear change of contact site/relation, or loss of assessable evidence. Do not infer contact through an unobservable gap.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从可见的下巴接触开始，排除靠近过程；在分离、接触部位／关系明确改变或证据无法评估时结束，不推断不可见区间内的接触。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this label is connected. Manual selection is available; future model assistance requires integration and evaluation. Spatial proximity alone must not be accepted as contact or self-support.
labels.evidence_mode: Video resolving the selected hand and the actor's own chin/cheek. Visible separation supports placement; contact and resting require their own visible evidence. BVH proximity alone cannot confirm contact or support, and no support force or internal state is measured.

labels.description_en: The selected hand visibly touches or remains against the actor's own cheek. Identify cheek side in notes when needed; hand side alone does not determine it. Use this contact description when a cheek-resting relation is not established; do not also count broader self-touch/hand-to-face descriptions.
labels.description_zh: 所选手可见地触及或贴住本人的脸颊；需要时在备注注明脸颊侧别，不能由左右手自动推出接触哪侧脸颊。接触明确但托腮姿态未成立时使用，不再重复计为较宽的自我触碰或手部触脸。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at visible cheek contact, excluding approach. End at separation, a clear change of cheek/contact relation, or loss of assessable evidence. Preserve uncertainty under occlusion.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从可见的脸颊接触开始，排除靠近过程；在分离、接触脸颊／关系明确改变或证据无法评估时结束，遮挡时保留不确定。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this label is connected. Manual selection is available; future model assistance requires integration and evaluation. Spatial proximity alone must not be accepted as contact or self-support.
labels.evidence_mode: Video resolving the selected hand and the actor's own chin/cheek. Visible separation supports placement; contact and resting require their own visible evidence. BVH proximity alone cannot confirm contact or support, and no support force or internal state is measured.

labels.description_en: The actor's chin visibly rests on the selected hand in a maintained support-like posture. Mere proximity or touch is insufficient. This describes an observable bodily relation, not a measured support force or thinking, boredom or fatigue. Use one specific relation label rather than duplicating its broader contact descriptions.
labels.description_zh: 本人的下巴可见地靠在所选手上，形成持续托住的姿态；仅靠近或碰触不足以成立。标注可观察的身体关系，不表示测得支撑力，也不代表思考、无聊或疲劳。同一关系使用这一具体标签，不再重复标较宽的接触标签。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the chin-resting posture is visibly established, excluding the hand approach. End when the resting relation ends, clearly changes, or can no longer be assessed. Retain one interval through minor readjustments that preserve it; record a change of supporting hand on its appropriate track.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从托下巴姿态可见地建立开始，排除手的靠近过程；在托住关系解除、明确改变或无法评估时结束。保持该关系的微调可留在同一区间，换手时在对应手部轨道记录。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this label is connected. Manual selection is available; future model assistance requires integration and evaluation. Spatial proximity alone must not be accepted as contact or self-support.
labels.evidence_mode: Video resolving the selected hand and the actor's own chin/cheek. Visible separation supports placement; contact and resting require their own visible evidence. BVH proximity alone cannot confirm contact or support, and no support force or internal state is measured.

labels.description_en: The actor's cheek or side of the face visibly rests against the selected hand in a maintained support-like posture. Mere touch is insufficient. Specify cheek side in notes when needed. Do not infer support force, emotion or listener status, and do not duplicate broader contact labels for this relation.
labels.description_zh: 本人的脸颊或侧脸可见地靠在所选手上，形成持续托腮姿态；仅碰触不足以成立。需要时在备注注明脸颊侧别。不推断支撑力、情感或倾听者身份，同一关系不重复标较宽的接触标签。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the cheek-resting posture is visibly established, excluding approach. End when it ends, changes to a different support/contact relation, or becomes unassessable. Minor readjustment does not by itself split the interval; a change of supporting hand belongs to the appropriate hand track.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从托腮姿态可见地建立开始，排除靠近过程；在关系解除、转为其他支撑／接触关系或无法评估时结束。轻微调整本身不要求拆段，换手时使用对应手部轨道。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this label is connected. Manual selection is available; future model assistance requires integration and evaluation. Spatial proximity alone must not be accepted as contact or self-support.
labels.evidence_mode: Video resolving the selected hand and the actor's own chin/cheek. Visible separation supports placement; contact and resting require their own visible evidence. BVH proximity alone cannot confirm contact or support, and no support force or internal state is measured.

labels.description_zh: 连续交替迈步，使身体在场景中发生位移。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first clear locomotor movement or weight transfer; end when it stops or another locomotor pattern begins. Annotate stationary as a sustained state, not a missing detection.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从位移、迈步或支撑转换开始，到其停止或类型改变结束；位置稳定是持续状态。

labels.description_zh: 身体支撑明显在脚或支撑区域之间转移，未形成明确迈步；BVH 本身不测足底压力。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first clear locomotor movement or weight transfer; end when it stops or another locomotor pattern begins. Annotate stationary as a sustained state, not a missing detection.

labels.description_en: The actor lowers from standing or another elevated posture into a seated support.
labels.description_zh: 身体从站立或较高姿势降低到坐姿支撑；与已经坐着分开。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start with the movement toward the seat; end when the seated posture is established.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从向座位运动开始，到坐姿建立结束。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this label is implemented in this release. The intended workflow uses explicit geometric or signal rules, followed by task-appropriate review.

labels.description_en: The actor rises from a seated or lower support into standing.
labels.description_zh: 身体从坐姿或较低支撑起身到站立。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start with the preparatory rise or weight transfer; end when standing support is established.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从准备性上升或重心转移开始，到站立支撑建立结束。
labels.auto_method: No detector for this label is implemented in this release. The intended workflow uses explicit geometric or signal rules, followed by task-appropriate review.
labels.evidence_mode: video / root and lower-body kinematics

labels.description_en: The actor lowers the body through coordinated hip and knee motion into a squat with support primarily through the feet. This whole-body transition is separate from local knee flexion and from the maintained squat.
labels.description_zh: 身体通过髋膝联合运动降低并进入蹲姿；属于全身姿态转换，与局部弯膝和持续蹲姿分开。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at departure from the preceding posture toward the squat; end when the squat is established. Do not extend the transition through the subsequent held squat.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从离开此前姿态并转向下蹲开始，到蹲姿建立结束；不把转换延伸到随后保持的蹲姿。
labels.auto_method: No squat/kneel transition detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires validated joint geometry, posture change and support evidence; kneeling additionally requires reliable knee contact/support evidence. Coarse leg motion is not this classification.
labels.evidence_mode: video / root and lower-body kinematics

labels.description_en: The actor rises out of an established squat toward a higher posture. Record the transition, not the preceding squat or the following maintained posture.
labels.description_zh: 身体离开已建立的蹲姿并上升到较高姿态；仅标起身过程。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at departure from the squat; end when the next posture is established or the rise clearly stops.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从离开蹲姿开始，到下一姿态建立或起身运动明确停止结束。
labels.auto_method: No squat/kneel transition detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires validated joint geometry, posture change and support evidence; kneeling additionally requires reliable knee contact/support evidence. Coarse leg motion is not this classification.

labels.description_en: The actor lowers into a kneeling configuration with one or both knees establishing visible contact/support with a surface. Knee bending or low knee height alone does not establish this transition.
labels.description_zh: 身体降低并进入一侧或双膝与支撑面建立可见接触／支撑的跪姿；仅弯膝或膝位置低不足以确认。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at departure from the preceding posture toward kneeling; end when the kneeling support/configuration is established. Review knee contact; when it cannot be established use locomotion uncertain.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从离开此前姿态并转向跪姿开始，到跪姿支撑／形态建立结束。复核膝部接触；无法确定时用 locomotion uncertain。
labels.auto_method: No squat/kneel transition detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires validated joint geometry, posture change and support evidence; kneeling additionally requires reliable knee contact/support evidence. Coarse leg motion is not this classification.
labels.evidence_mode: video / root and lower-body kinematics

labels.description_en: The actor rises out of an established kneeling support/configuration, leaving knee support for a higher posture. Do not infer the starting support relation solely from knee height in BVH.
labels.description_zh: 身体离开已建立的跪姿支撑并向较高姿态起身；起点跪姿关系需有可靠证据，不能只由 BVH 膝高度推出。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at departure from the kneeling configuration; end when the next posture is established or the rise clearly stops. Exclude the held postures at either end.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从离开跪姿形态开始，到下一姿态建立或起身运动明确停止结束，排除两端保持的姿态。
labels.auto_method: No squat/kneel transition detector is implemented in this release. A future rule requires validated joint geometry, posture change and support evidence; kneeling additionally requires reliable knee contact/support evidence. Coarse leg motion is not this classification.
labels.evidence_mode: video / root and lower-body kinematics

labels.description_en: The actor remains in approximately the same scene location; arms or other body parts may still move.
labels.description_zh: 身体在场景中的位置大致稳定，手臂或其他部位仍可活动。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the reviewed interval without meaningful root displacement under the project criterion; end when a locomotor displacement begins.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标已审阅且按项目标准没有明显根节点位移的区间，到移动位移开始时结束。

labels.description_en: Body displacement or support movement is evident but cannot be classified reliably.
labels.description_zh: 身体位移或支撑变化可见，但具体类型不确定。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the interval for which available evidence supports competing or unresolved classifications. End when a specific interpretation becomes supported or the relevant event ends; state the uncertainty in notes.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标可用证据支持竞争解释或类型仍未确定的区间；在具体解释获得支持或相关事件结束时停止，并在备注说明不确定性。

labels.description_en: The lower body or root motion cannot be assessed from the available evidence.

labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the relevant body part or action can no longer be assessed; end when sufficient usable evidence returns. Do not infer behavior within the obscured interval.

labels.description_en: A visible falling descent of the body into a lower support configuration or interception by another person. The motion may be performed intentionally; injury and involuntary cause are not inferred.

labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从离开此前位置开始，到表达性主动作开始时结束；若手势直接从主动作开始，不强行添加准备阶段。

labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the onset of the expressive movement; end when that expressive movement is complete, before a subsequent hold or retraction. Use context as well as speed.

labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the gesture pose becomes maintained; end when the next stroke or retraction begins. Include only the gesture-related hold, not unrelated rest.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从手势姿态开始保持，到下一主动作或回收开始时结束；只包含与手势有关的保持，不纳入无关静置。

labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the expressive stroke or hold is released; end when the return is complete or another gesture begins.

labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when fingers or the hand begin closing into the object grip; end when the grasp is established. Mark sustained holding separately.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从手指或手开始闭合形成物体抓握开始，到抓握建立结束；持续持有另标。

labels.description_zh: 物体在人的控制下离开原支撑面并被抬起。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the object begins leaving its support under actor control; end when the lift is complete or transitions to transport or holding.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从物体在人物控制下开始离开支撑面，到抬起完成或转为运送／持有结束。

labels.description_zh: 人将物体移到新的支撑面或稳定支撑上，松手可以另行标注。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at movement toward the support; end when the object is supported there and the placement movement ends. Release can be a separate operation.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从朝支撑面运动开始，到物体在那里获得支撑且放置运动结束；松手可作为独立操作。

labels.description_zh: 人解除对物体的抓握或控制。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at visible opening or release of the established grip; end when grip or support by that hand ceases.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从可见张手或解除已建立抓握开始，到该手的抓握或支撑解除结束。
labels.auto_method: No end-to-end detector for this label is available in the current GUI. Additional model/data integration and evaluation are required.

labels.description_zh: 手持续抓握或支撑并控制物体；关系方向为人控制物体。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when holding control is established; end when the actor releases it or control is lost. Object movement may overlap with holding.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从持有控制建立开始，到人物释放物体或失去控制结束；物体运动可以与持有状态重叠。
labels.auto_method: No end-to-end detector for this label is available in the current GUI. Additional model/data integration and evaluation are required.

labels.description_zh: 身体部位可见地接触物体，不要求抓握、抬起或操作；仅接近不足以成立。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at visible contact and end at separation. Mere spatial proximity or BVH overlap is insufficient evidence of contact.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从可见接触开始，到分离结束；仅空间接近或 BVH 重叠不足以证明接触。
labels.auto_method: No end-to-end detector for this label is available in the current GUI. Additional model/data integration and evaluation are required.

labels.description_en: The selected body part remains visibly placed on an object surface, such as a hand resting on a table. This state does not imply emotional relaxation or a measured contact force.
labels.description_zh: 身体部位持续搁置在物体表面，如右手搁在桌面；不推断心理放松或准确受力。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the body part establishes a sustained placement on the surface; end when it separates or changes relation. Include the whole maintained state regardless of speech boundaries.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从身体部位持续放置于表面开始，到分离或关系改变结束；包含整个保持状态，不随说话边界切分。

labels.evidence_mode: video with visible object/contact; optional calibrated body and object geometry

labels.description_en: The actor maintains a seated posture on an identified object such as a sofa or chair. Identify the supporting object; this is the seated state, not the sit-down movement.
labels.description_zh: 身体在指定物体上保持坐姿，如坐在 sofa_01；坐下过程另行标注。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when seated support on the object is established; end when the actor rises, leaves the support or changes to another relation. The sitting posture may be linked without drawing the same interval twice.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从物体上的坐姿支撑建立开始，到人物起身、离开支撑或转为另一关系结束；可关联坐姿记录，不必再次画相同区间。
labels.auto_method: No automatic relation detector is implemented. Future candidates require visible contact or calibrated body/object geometry; a centroid or joint proximity alone is insufficient.

labels.description_en: The selected body region remains visibly leaned against an identified object, such as a torso against a sofa back. Record the maintained relation without estimating force.
labels.description_zh: 身体部位持续倚靠指定物体，如躯干靠在沙发靠背上；不估计接触力。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the visible leaning relation is established; end when contact or the leaning configuration clearly ceases. Mark approach and departure movements separately when needed.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从可见倚靠关系建立开始，到接触或倚靠形态明确解除结束；需要时另标靠近与离开运动。
labels.auto_method: No automatic relation detector is implemented. Future candidates require visible contact or calibrated body/object geometry; a centroid or joint proximity alone is insufficient.
labels.evidence_mode: video with visible object/contact; optional calibrated body and object geometry

labels.description_en: The actor maintains a lying or reclined body configuration on an identified supporting object. Sleep, comfort and intention are not inferred.
labels.description_zh: 身体在指定支撑物上保持躺卧或斜躺配置，不推断睡眠、舒适或意图。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the lying relation to the object is established; end when the actor rises, leaves it or changes to another posture. Exclude the transition into or out of the state.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从相对物体的卧姿关系建立开始，到人物起身、离开或转为另一姿态结束；排除进出该状态的转换。
labels.auto_method: No automatic relation detector is implemented. Future candidates require visible contact or calibrated body/object geometry; a centroid or joint proximity alone is insufficient.
labels.evidence_mode: video with visible object/contact; optional calibrated body and object geometry

labels.description_en: The actor stands on an identified object or support surface such as a platform. Record the object instance rather than inferring it from body height alone.
labels.description_zh: 身体在指定物体或支撑面上站立；不能仅凭身体高度猜测物体。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when standing support on the identified object is established; end when the actor steps away or changes to another support or posture.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从已识别物体上的站立支撑建立开始，到人物迈离或转为另一支撑／姿态结束。
labels.auto_method: No automatic relation detector is implemented. Future candidates require visible contact or calibrated body/object geometry; a centroid or joint proximity alone is insufficient.
labels.evidence_mode: video with visible object/contact; optional calibrated body and object geometry

labels.description_en: Visible posture and contact support that the actor uses the selected body part against an object for bodily support, such as bracing the hands on a table. Mere proximity does not establish load bearing; exact force is not measured.
labels.description_zh: 可见接触和姿态支持身体借物体支撑或撑住；仅接近不足以证明承重，准确力值未知。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when a supported or braced body configuration is visibly established; end when that support is released or its configuration changes. If support cannot be distinguished from touch, use touch object or contact uncertain.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从可见支撑或撑住身体的形态建立开始，到支撑解除或形态改变结束；无法区别支撑与触碰时用 touch object 或 contact uncertain。
labels.auto_method: No automatic relation detector is implemented. Future candidates require visible contact or calibrated body/object geometry; a centroid or joint proximity alone is insufficient.
labels.evidence_mode: video with visible object/contact; optional calibrated body and object geometry

labels.description_en: The actor applies visible contact that moves or attempts to move an object away along a direction.
labels.description_zh: 可见接触使物体向外移动或明显试图推动物体。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the visible pushing effort or resulting displacement; end when the effort or directed movement stops.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从可见推动用力或其导致的位移开始，到用力或定向运动停止结束。

labels.description_en: The actor draws an object toward the body or along a pulling direction through an established contact or grasp.
labels.description_zh: 通过接触或抓握，将物体向身体或指定方向拉动。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the visible pulling effort or resulting displacement; end when that effort or directed movement stops.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从可见拉动用力或其导致的位移开始，到该用力或定向运动停止结束。
labels.auto_method: No end-to-end detector for this label is available in the current GUI. Additional model/data integration and evaluation are required.
labels.evidence_mode: video with visible object/contact; optional calibrated body and object geometry

labels.description_en: The actor performs an identifiable operation with an object, beyond simply holding it; describe the operation in notes.
labels.description_zh: 对物体实施可识别的功能操作，超出单纯持有；在备注中说明操作。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the active operation from first functional manipulation to its completion; do not include unrelated holding before or after.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从首次具有功能的操作到操作完成标主动使用过程，不包含前后无关的持有状态。
labels.auto_method: No end-to-end detector for this label is available in the current GUI. Additional model/data integration and evaluation are required.
labels.evidence_mode: video with visible object/contact; optional calibrated body and object geometry

labels.description_en: The actor repositions a chair, table or other furniture item.
labels.description_zh: 重新放置椅子、桌子或其他家具。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first controlled furniture displacement; end when the item stops in its new position or the actor abandons the move.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从家具首次受控位移开始，到物品在新位置停止或人物放弃移动结束。
labels.auto_method: No end-to-end detector for this label is available in the current GUI. Additional model/data integration and evaluation are required.
labels.evidence_mode: video with visible object/contact; optional calibrated body and object geometry

labels.description_en: The selected actor presents and transfers an object to another person; an offer without transfer can be recorded as an Interaction Event.
labels.description_zh: 将物体呈现并交给另一人，区分实际转移与仅发出提供意向。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at presentation of the object for transfer; end when the receiver has control and the giver releases, or the attempted transfer clearly stops.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从为转交而呈递物体开始，到接收者取得控制且给予者松手，或转交尝试明确停止结束。
labels.auto_method: No end-to-end detector for this label is available in the current GUI. Additional model/data integration and evaluation are required.
labels.evidence_mode: video with visible object/contact; optional calibrated body and object geometry

labels.description_en: The selected actor acquires an object from another person.
labels.description_zh: 从另一人处获得对物体的控制。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at reaching or contact that visibly participates in the receipt; end when receiving control is established or the attempt stops.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从可见参与接收的伸手或接触开始，到接收控制建立或尝试停止结束。
labels.auto_method: No end-to-end detector for this label is available in the current GUI. Additional model/data integration and evaluation are required.
labels.evidence_mode: video with visible object/contact; optional calibrated body and object geometry

labels.description_en: A visible object-related action is outside this list; describe the object and action in notes.

labels.description_en: An actor holds or claims a conversational turn, which may include internal pauses. Automatic grouping of attributed speech is a proposal and does not resolve every backchannel or floor-competition case.

labels.boundary_rule_en: Begin at the first contribution taking or claiming the turn; end when the turn is yielded or abandoned. Preserve a turn across its internal pauses and verified backchannels where supported by context.

labels.description_en: A candidate boundary at the incoming turn onset when the adjacent attributed turns change actor. A backchannel or simultaneous entry may not constitute a conversational floor transfer.

labels.boundary_rule_en: Place a point at the incoming contribution onset under this project convention. Preserve the outgoing end and source turn IDs separately; a point does not claim a measurable transition duration.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 按项目约定标在接入贡献的起点，是单个时间点；前一轮结束与前后源 ID 另存。
labels.auto_method: Built-in derivation from attributed turn candidates. The point convention is the incoming start; outgoing end, source IDs and signed gap are retained as relation evidence. No social handover classifier is claimed.

labels.description_en: A reviewed conversational floor transfer from one actor to another. Link the outgoing and incoming turns when known, and keep any gap or overlap as a separate timing value.

labels.boundary_rule_en: Place a point at the incoming contribution onset under this project convention. Preserve the outgoing end and source turn IDs separately; a point does not claim a measurable transition duration.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 按项目约定标在接入贡献的起点，是单个时间点；前一轮结束与前后源 ID 另存。
labels.auto_method: An acoustic speaker-change candidate can locate a review opportunity. Its conversational meaning requires context; no automatic handover classifier is implemented.

labels.description_zh: 接入贡献的起点可观察，但是否真正转移话轮尚不确定。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Place a single point at the incoming contribution onset under the project convention. Record the unresolved interpretation in notes; do not expand the marker to an arbitrary duration.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 按项目约定，在接入贡献开始处放置单个时间点；在备注记录未确定的解释，不将标记扩成任意时长。

labels.description_en: Attributed speech by R01 and R02 occurs simultaneously. The intersection is a timing relation, not proof of interruption.
labels.description_zh: R01 与 R02 的语音区间在时间上相交；重叠本身不证明打断。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Use the positive-duration intersection of the two actors speech intervals; exclude one-sided speech. Source attribution and missed speech affect the result.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 取双方言语区间具有正时长的交集，排除仅一人说话的部分；来源归属与漏检言语会影响结果。
labels.auto_method: Built-in interval arithmetic over source Speaking / Speech Turn records. Derived records retain source references and remain predictions unless their evidence has been reviewed.
labels.evidence_mode: attributed speech intervals and source turn intervals

labels.description_en: A gap between attributed speech segments lies within the same retained turn. Absence of detected speech is not absence of all sound or vocalization.
labels.description_zh: 同一保留话轮内部的语音片段之间有间隔；未检出言语不等于没有其他声音或发声。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Use the gap between successive same-actor speech segments within the turn. Do not create a pause over another segment of that actor or across a true turn transfer.

labels.evidence_mode: Manual observation relative to a named object or region. No mesh, prop trajectory or geometric model is required.

labels.description_en: The actor is inside the meaningful region represented by the named target, such as a booth or waiting area. Name the region explicitly; this does not mean physically inside a solid counter or other solid body.
labels.description_zh: 人物整体在所选命名区域内部，例如隔间、等候区。应给区域明确命名，不解释为人物位于柜台等实体物体内部。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the interval in which the actor occupies the stated position relative to the named target. End when that relation changes or cannot be judged. Use a consistent whole-person position reference; a reaching hand alone does not move the person into a new region.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标人物整体与所选物体的关系成立的区间，在关系改变或无法判断时结束。人物位置使用一致的身体／地面参照，不因一只手伸过去就改变整个人的位置标签。

labels.description_en: The actor is outside the meaningful region represented by the named target. The region boundary must be interpretable under the project protocol; absence of a model is not evidence of being outside.
labels.description_zh: 人物整体在所选命名区域外部；区域边界需按项目约定可判断，不能因没有物体模型就认定为区域外。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the interval in which the actor occupies the stated position relative to the named target. End when that relation changes or cannot be judged. Use a consistent whole-person position reference; a reaching hand alone does not move the person into a new region.

labels.description_en: The actor occupies the approximate central part of a named meaningful region under the project convention. This is not exact geometric-center measurement and does not refer to the center of a solid object.
labels.description_zh: 人物整体处于命名区域的大致中央，按项目约定判断，不表示精确几何中心测量，也不指实体物体内部的中心。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the interval in which the actor occupies the stated position relative to the named target. End when that relation changes or cannot be judged. Use a consistent whole-person position reference; a reaching hand alone does not move the person into a new region.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标人物整体与所选物体的关系成立的区间，在关系改变或无法判断时结束。人物位置使用一致的身体／地面参照，不因一只手伸过去就改变整个人的位置标签。

labels.label_zh: 人与物体位置关系不确定
labels.description_en: The person-to-object position cannot be classified reliably. Keep the target when known; an unavailable target may remain unspecified. Do not fill unreviewed gaps with this label.
labels.description_zh: 人物与物体的位置关系无法可靠分类；知道目标时保留目标，不知道时允许留空。不用此项填满未审阅空隙。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the reviewed interval in which the position relation cannot be classified reliably. End when classification becomes possible or observation ends; do not fill unreviewed gaps.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标已审阅但位置关系无法可靠判断的区间，在能明确分类或观察结束时结束；不覆盖未审阅空隙。
labels.auto_method: Manual annotation against named objects/regions. No automatic geometry, distance, region or relation detector is connected; registration alone does not supply such measurements.
labels.evidence_mode: Manual observation relative to a named object or region. No mesh, prop trajectory or geometric model is required.

labels.description_en: The actor moves so that their whole-person position becomes closer to the named target. This does not require reaching, contact or an intention to use the object; target motion alone is insufficient.
labels.description_zh: 人物自身移动，使整体位置向所选目标接近；不要求伸手、接触或使用意图，仅物体移动不足以成立。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the actor movement that establishes the named relative change; end at completion, a clear stop or a change of movement. A moving target alone does not establish actor movement. Exclude the subsequent held spatial state.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从人物产生所述相对变化的运动开始，到完成、明确停止或运动改变结束；物体单独移动不算人物的该项运动，不包含随后保持的位置状态。

labels.evidence_mode: Manual observation relative to a named object or region. No mesh, prop trajectory or geometric model is required.

labels.description_en: The actor moves so that their whole-person position becomes farther from the named target. No social avoidance or rejection is inferred.
labels.description_zh: 人物自身移动，使整体位置离所选目标更远，不推断社会回避或拒绝。

labels.description_en: The actor moves past the named object, continuing beyond it. Annotate the observable passage, not the whole walk or an inferred destination.
labels.description_zh: 人物从所选物体旁经过并继续越过它，标实际经过过程，不延长到整段行走或推断目的地。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the actor movement that establishes the named relative change; end at completion, a clear stop or a change of movement. A moving target alone does not establish actor movement. Exclude the subsequent held spatial state.

labels.description_en: The actor follows a path around the named object. A complete circuit is not required; merely turning the torso or the target rotating is insufficient.
labels.description_zh: 人物沿所选物体周围绕行，不要求绕满一圈；仅转动躯干或物体自身旋转不足以成立。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the actor movement that establishes the named relative change; end at completion, a clear stop or a change of movement. A moving target alone does not establish actor movement. Exclude the subsequent held spatial state.

labels.description_en: The actor moves from outside to inside the meaningful region represented by the named target. Mark the entry transition; the subsequently maintained inside state is separate.
labels.description_zh: 人物从命名区域外移动进入区域内，标进入转换过程，随后保持在内部的状态另记。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the actor movement that establishes the named relative change; end at completion, a clear stop or a change of movement. A moving target alone does not establish actor movement. Exclude the subsequent held spatial state.

labels.evidence_mode: Manual observation relative to a named object or region. No mesh, prop trajectory or geometric model is required.

labels.description_en: The actor moves from inside to outside the meaningful region represented by the named target. Mark the exit transition, not the whole following walk.
labels.description_zh: 人物从命名区域内部移到外部，标离开转换过程，不延伸到其后整个行走区间。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the actor movement that establishes the named relative change; end at completion, a clear stop or a change of movement. A moving target alone does not establish actor movement. Exclude the subsequent held spatial state.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从人物产生所述相对变化的运动开始，到完成、明确停止或运动改变结束；物体单独移动不算人物的该项运动，不包含随后保持的位置状态。
