labels.description_en: Actor movement relative to an object or region is observable but cannot be classified reliably. Keep the target when known; do not infer a destination or fabricate an unknown target.
labels.description_zh: 可观察到人物相对于物体或区域的运动，但无法可靠分类；知道目标时保留目标，不推断目的地或编造未知目标。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark reviewed actor movement whose object-relative type cannot be classified reliably. End when movement stops, classification becomes possible or observation ends; do not fill unreviewed gaps.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标已审阅且确有运动但相对物体的移动类型无法可靠分类的区间；在运动停止、能明确分类或观察结束时结束，不覆盖未审阅空隙。

labels.description_en: The actor performs a contextual bid for the partner's attention; a movement alone or an Oculo gaze direction alone is insufficient.
labels.description_zh: 人物在上下文中作出引起伙伴注意的尝试，仅动作或注视方向不足。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first action constituting the event; end when it resolves or clearly ceases. Separate initiative and response when actor direction matters; record target and supporting cues.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从执行该社会功能的首个贡献开始，到贡献完成或停止结束；仅在有依据时明确发起者与对象。
labels.auto_method: Manual evidence-based annotation. The label does not infer an internal state, intention or unobserved outcome.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: An actor asks the partner for information, an action or an object in context.
labels.description_zh: 向伙伴请求信息、行动或物品。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the requesting contribution from onset to completion; do not include the partner response in the same actor event.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标请求贡献从开始到完成的过程，不把伙伴回应纳入同一人物事件。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: An actor proposes an action, resource or object to the partner; an unaccepted offer remains an offer.
labels.description_zh: 向伙伴提出行动、资源或物品的提供，即使未被接受仍可记录提供。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the offering contribution or presentation from onset to completion. Acceptance or transfer is recorded separately.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标提供提议或呈递从开始到完成的过程；接受或实际转交另行记录。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: The actor asks the partner for help; absence of a response does not by itself mean refusal.
labels.description_zh: 人物请求伙伴帮助，无回应本身不等于拒绝。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first action constituting the event; end when it resolves or clearly ceases. Separate initiative and response when actor direction matters; record target and supporting cues.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从执行该社会功能的首个贡献开始，到贡献完成或停止结束；仅在有依据时明确发起者与对象。
labels.auto_method: Manual evidence-based annotation. The label does not infer an internal state, intention or unobserved outcome.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: The actor offers help to the partner; actual bodily assistance and acceptance are separate events.
labels.description_zh: 人物向伙伴提出帮助，实际身体帮助与是否接受另标。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first action constituting the event; end when it resolves or clearly ceases. Separate initiative and response when actor direction matters; record target and supporting cues.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从执行该社会功能的首个贡献开始，到贡献完成或停止结束；仅在有依据时明确发起者与对象。
labels.auto_method: Manual evidence-based annotation. The label does not infer an internal state, intention or unobserved outcome.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: An action or utterance indicates receipt or recognition of a partner contribution; a nod or sound alone is not conclusive.
labels.description_zh: 动作或话语表示已收到或识别伙伴贡献；仅点头或发声不充分。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the acknowledgment action or utterance from onset to offset, without extending across the whole preceding contribution.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从确认接收到对方贡献的动作或话语起点标到终点，不扩展到整个前述贡献。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: An actor observably accepts an offer, proposal or request in context.
labels.description_zh: 可观察地接受提议、提供或请求；静默本身不构成接受。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the accepting contribution or action. Silence alone is not evidence of acceptance.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标表示接受的贡献或行动；静默本身不能作为接受的证据。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: An actor observably declines an offer, proposal or request in context.
labels.description_zh: 可观察地拒绝提议、提供或请求；静默、转头或远离本身不充分。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the declining contribution or action. Silence, looking away or moving away alone is not evidence of refusal.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标表示拒绝的贡献或行动；仅静默、看向别处或远离不足以证明拒绝。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: The actor communicates agreement with a proposition or proposal; a kinematic nod alone is insufficient.
labels.description_zh: 人物传达对命题或建议的赞同，单纯点头运动不足。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first action constituting the event; end when it resolves or clearly ceases. Separate initiative and response when actor direction matters; record target and supporting cues.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从执行该社会功能的首个贡献开始，到贡献完成或停止结束；仅在有依据时明确发起者与对象。
labels.auto_method: Manual evidence-based annotation. The label does not infer an internal state, intention or unobserved outcome.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: The actor communicates disagreement with a proposition or proposal; a head shake alone does not establish the function.
labels.description_zh: 人物传达对命题或建议的不赞同，单纯摇头不能确定功能。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first action constituting the event; end when it resolves or clearly ceases. Separate initiative and response when actor direction matters; record target and supporting cues.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从执行该社会功能的首个贡献开始，到贡献完成或停止结束；仅在有依据时明确发起者与对象。
labels.auto_method: Manual evidence-based annotation. The label does not infer an internal state, intention or unobserved outcome.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: The participants observably coordinate contributions toward a shared activity supported by context; synchrony alone is insufficient.
labels.description_zh: 上下文支持双方围绕共同活动协调贡献，仅运动同步不足。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first action constituting the event; end when it resolves or clearly ceases. Separate initiative and response when actor direction matters; record target and supporting cues.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从执行该社会功能的首个贡献开始，到贡献完成或停止结束；仅在有依据时明确发起者与对象。
labels.auto_method: Manual evidence-based annotation. The label does not infer an internal state, intention or unobserved outcome.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: A coordinated exchange transfers an object from one participant to another; physical giver and receiver actions can also be annotated in HOI.
labels.description_zh: 双方协调交换物品，控制权由给予者转到接收者；各人的物理动作可在 HOI 分别记录。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the presentation or receiving action that initiates the exchange; end when control transfers or the exchange attempt clearly stops. Identify giver and receiver.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从发起交换的呈递或接收动作开始，到控制转移或交换尝试明确停止结束；注明给予者与接收者。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: Observable contributions are present but the available context does not support a reliable social-event interpretation.
labels.description_zh: 互动贡献可观察，但上下文不足以可靠确定社会意义。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the interval for which available evidence supports competing or unresolved classifications. End when a specific interpretation becomes supported or the relevant event ends; state the uncertainty in notes.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标可用证据支持竞争解释或类型仍未确定的区间；在具体解释获得支持或相关事件结束时停止，并在备注说明不确定性。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: An action or utterance is directed as a greeting in context; a greeting attempt does not require a successful response.
labels.description_zh: 动作或话语在上下文中用于问候，问候尝试不要求对方已经回应。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first greeting action or utterance and end at its completion. A response can be separately marked on the responding actor track.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从首个问候动作或话语开始，到其完成结束；回应可在回应者轨道单独标注。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: An actor visibly or audibly attempts to open an exchange with a partner; moving closer alone is insufficient.
labels.description_zh: 一人通过可见或可听贡献尝试开启与伙伴的互动；仅接近不充分。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the initiating contribution from onset to completion or abandonment. Record the intended target when supported by evidence.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标发起贡献从开始到完成或放弃的过程；证据支持时记录其针对的对象。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: An action or utterance functions as leave-taking or closing an encounter in context.
labels.description_zh: 动作或话语在上下文中用于告别或结束接触。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the farewell contribution or exchange from its first closing action to its resolution; later physical departure can be a separate event.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从首个结束接触的动作到告别贡献或交换解决标该过程；之后的身体离开可作为独立事件。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: Context supports that an actor ends participation in the ongoing exchange; increasing distance alone is insufficient.
labels.description_zh: 上下文支持一人结束参与当前交流；仅增加距离不足以成立。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the observable disengagement or departure that constitutes leaving; end when participation has clearly ceased or the departure action ends.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从构成离开的可观察退出参与或离开动作开始，到参与明确停止或离开动作完成结束。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: An action or utterance is contextually linked to a preceding contribution by the partner; temporal succession alone is insufficient.
labels.description_zh: 动作或话语在上下文中回应伙伴此前的贡献；仅时间先后不充分。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the responding contribution itself. Record the preceding event or reference time in notes where possible.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 只标回应贡献本身；尽可能在备注记录此前事件或参考时间。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: Context supports that one actor reproduces a partner action; similarity or a time lag alone is insufficient.
labels.description_zh: 上下文支持一人复现伙伴动作；相似或时滞本身不证明模仿。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the imitating action and record the model actor and source interval in notes. When the evidence supports only similarity or timing, retain the individual motion observations.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标模仿动作，并在备注记录被模仿人物与源区间；证据只支持相似或时间对应时，分别保留两人的运动记录。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: An observable social action or exchange falls outside the listed types; describe its meaning and evidence in notes.
labels.description_zh: 存在可观察的社交动作或交流，但不属于已列类型。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first action constituting the event; end when it resolves or clearly ceases. Separate initiative and response when actor direction matters; record target and supporting cues.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从构成事件的首个贡献开始，到事件解决或停止结束；需要时分别记录发起与回应。
labels.auto_method: This release provides manual annotation for this label. Interpret evidence using the definition and preserve uncertainty.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: The actor invites the partner to participate in an activity or interaction.
labels.description_zh: 人物邀请伙伴参与某活动或互动。
labels.boundary_rule_en: Start at the first action constituting the event; end when it resolves or clearly ceases. Separate initiative and response when actor direction matters; record target and supporting cues.
labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从执行该社会功能的首个贡献开始，到贡献完成或停止结束；仅在有依据时明确发起者与对象。
labels.auto_method: Manual evidence-based annotation. The label does not infer an internal state, intention or unobserved outcome.
labels.evidence_mode: multimodal interaction context

labels.description_en: The actor communicates thanks for a contribution, object or action in the interaction.

labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从有证据的怒意爆发或明显升级开始，到该表达缓和或结束。形式不清时可用 Angry，单凭音量不足以判定。

labels.description_en: The actor’s expression conveys a perceived loss of hope or a sense that there is no way forward.

labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标有言语或情境线索支持绝望感的区间。单凭哭泣、静止或悲伤不足以判定。

labels.description_en: The actor expresses positive regard for an achievement or quality they associate with themselves or someone they identify with.

labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the expressed self- or group-related appraisal. Upright posture or a successful outcome alone is insufficient.

labels.description_en: The actor conveys apprehension about an uncertain or anticipated outcome.

archived_labels.label_zh: 抬起—保持—放下序列候选
archived_labels.description_en: A proposed arm sequence containing a raise, a quiet high-pose interval and a lowering movement; a quiet signal is not proof of a deliberate hold.
archived_labels.description_zh: 抬臂后接低运动量间隔再放下的结构候选；需要检查中间是否确实保持高位姿态。
archived_labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the sequence from raise onset to lower offset. Inspect the proposed hold against the visible pose; annotate individual movements separately when that detail is needed.
archived_labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从抬起开始到放下结束标整个序列。根据可见姿态复核候选保持段；研究需要细节时另标各个运动。
archived_labels.policy: keep pending or choose a specific label before Accept; preserve historical reviews

archived_labels.description_en: A proposed arm raise followed by lowering without a confirmed intervening hold.
archived_labels.description_zh: 抬臂后接放下的结构候选，中间没有已确认的保持阶段。
archived_labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the sequence from raise onset to lower offset. Split the component phases onto separate tracks if the task requires phase-level timing.
archived_labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从抬起开始到放下结束标整个序列；若任务需要阶段级时间，在独立轨道上标注各组成阶段。
archived_labels.policy: keep pending or choose a specific label before Accept; preserve historical reviews

archived_labels.description_en: Both arms of the same actor are active in overlapping time; this is not a two-person interaction label.
archived_labels.description_zh: 同一个人的两臂在时间上共同活动；不表示双人互动，也不自动证明对称或协调。
archived_labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark only the interval or proposed group containing activity in both arms. Check the actual overlap and do not infer symmetry or coordination from timing alone.
archived_labels.boundary_rule_zh: 只标包含双臂活动的区间或候选组合。检查实际重叠，不仅凭时序推断对称或协调。
archived_labels.policy: keep pending or choose a specific label before Accept; preserve historical reviews

archived_labels.description_en: The reviewed interval contains no reliable cue for a more specific perceived affect; this is not proof of an emotionally neutral internal state.
archived_labels.description_zh: 已复核区间缺少明确情感线索，不证明参与者内心处于中性状态。
archived_labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark only the interval with supporting cues. End when the impression changes or evidence becomes insufficient; record the cues and uncertainty in notes.
archived_labels.boundary_rule_zh: 仅标有支持线索的区间，线索改变或不足时结束，并记录判断依据。
archived_labels.policy: preserve original identity and meaning; no automatic relabeling

archived_labels.description_en: An unfinished annotation with no semantic label selected; it does not mean the behavior is absent.
archived_labels.description_zh: 尚未选择语义标签的草稿，不表示该行为不存在。
archived_labels.boundary_rule_en: Keep the provisional interval or point while editing. Choose a meaningful label, including a specific uncertainty label where appropriate, before Accept.
archived_labels.boundary_rule_zh: 编辑时保留暂定区间或时间点；在接收前选择有意义的标签，包括适用时的明确不确定性标签。
archived_labels.policy: preserve original identity and meaning; no automatic relabeling

archived_labels.label_zh: 双人手臂同时活动（关系未证实）
archived_labels.description_en: Arm-activity intervals overlap across two actors. A response, synchrony, imitation or other social relationship has not been established.
archived_labels.description_zh: 两人的手臂活动区间重叠；尚未建立回应、同步或模仿等关系。
archived_labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the common interval in which both actors have arm activity. Check each actor track and do not extend to unrelated surrounding movements.
archived_labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标双方都有手臂活动的共同区间。分别检查两人的轨道，不扩展到周围无关动作。
archived_labels.policy: preserve original identity and meaning; no automatic relabeling

archived_labels.description_en: Both actors visibly move during a shared time interval; the movement need not have similar form, rhythm or function.
archived_labels.description_zh: 两人在同一时间段内都发生运动，不要求动作相似或有相同功能。
archived_labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the interval with movement in both actors. Exclude one-sided lead-in and trailing movement.
archived_labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标双方都有运动的区间，排除仅一人运动的前导与尾随部分。
archived_labels.policy: preserve original identity and meaning; no automatic relabeling

archived_labels.description_en: Repeated or sustained movements have a consistent temporal relation under a stated comparison criterion; one accidental overlap is insufficient.
archived_labels.description_zh: 重复或持续运动在明确定义的比较准则下具有稳定时间对应；偶然一次重叠不足以成立。
archived_labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark only the span with repeated or sustained timing correspondence. Record the compared body parts, lag and project tolerance in notes.
archived_labels.boundary_rule_zh: 只标具有重复或持续时序对应的区间；在备注记录比较部位、时滞与项目容差。
archived_labels.policy: preserve original identity and meaning; no automatic relabeling

archived_labels.description_en: A later movement resembles or corresponds to an earlier movement by the other actor with an observable lag, without inferring causation.
archived_labels.description_zh: 一人的较晚动作与另一人的较早动作相似或对应，记录时滞，不推断因果。
archived_labels.boundary_rule_en: Include the source movement and corresponding later movement as one reviewed relation interval; record both component times and lag in notes.
archived_labels.boundary_rule_zh: 把源动作及稍后对应动作合为一段经过审阅的关系区间，并在备注记录两个组成动作的时间与时滞。
archived_labels.policy: preserve original identity and meaning; no automatic relabeling

archived_labels.description_en: The two participants maintain comparable visible body configurations; imitation, rapport or intent is not inferred.
archived_labels.description_zh: 两人维持相似身体配置，需说明比较部位及是否按左右镜像比较；不自动解释为模仿。
archived_labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the span with the relevant similarity in both actors. Record the compared posture features and any left-right mirroring in notes.
archived_labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标双方存在相关姿态相似性的区间，并在备注记录比较的姿态特征及是否存在左右镜像。
archived_labels.policy: preserve original identity and meaning; no automatic relabeling

archived_labels.description_en: Both actors are observable but the proposed temporal or postural relation remains ambiguous.
archived_labels.description_zh: 两人均可观察，但时间或姿态关系仍有歧义。
archived_labels.boundary_rule_en: Mark the interval for which available evidence supports competing or unresolved classifications. End when a specific interpretation becomes supported or the relevant event ends; state the uncertainty in notes.
archived_labels.boundary_rule_zh: 标可用证据支持竞争解释或类型仍未确定的区间；在具体解释获得支持或相关事件结束时停止，并在备注说明不确定性。
archived_labels.policy: preserve original identity and meaning; no automatic relabeling

archived_labels.description_en: The synchronized evidence from one or both actors is inadequate to assess an activity relation.
archived_labels.description_zh: 一人或两人的同步证据不足，无法判断活动关系。
archived_labels.boundary_rule_en: Start when the evidence needed for this type is absent or unusable; end when an assessment becomes possible. This interval does not establish absence of the behavior.
archived_labels.boundary_rule_zh: 从该类型所需证据缺失或不可用时开始，到能够评估时结束；此区间不表示已经确认行为不存在。
archived_labels.policy: preserve original identity and meaning; no automatic relabeling
